description: This is a C header file defining interfaces, constants, and types for managing flash memory operations on embedded hardware (e.g., STM32 microcontrollers). It includes definitions for sectors, addresses, error codes, and functions for erasing, reading, writing, and comparing flash memory.

methods.name: flashSectorSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorBegin
methods.description: Returns the starting address of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorEnd
methods.description: Returns the ending address (exclusive) of a specified flash sector.

methods.name: flashSectorAt
methods.description: Determines which sector contains a given flash address.

methods.name: flashSectorErase
methods.description: Erases a specified flash sector, with error checking and permission considerations.

methods.name: flashErase
methods.description: Erases a span of flash memory starting at a given address for a specified size.

methods.name: flashIsErased
methods.description: Checks whether a specified memory region in flash is erased.

methods.name: flashCompare
methods.description: Compares a buffer with flash memory content to verify data integrity.

methods.name: flashRead
methods.description: Copies data from flash memory into a buffer.

methods.name: flashWrite
methods.description: Copies data from a buffer into flash memory, assuming the target area is erased.
